title: Innovation intermediaries in sustainability transitions: A systematic review
authors: Kivimaa P; Boon W; Hyysalo S; Klerkx L
abstract: This paper reviews the role of intermediaries in sustainability transitions. We identify five types of intermediary activities and their functions in transition processes.

title: The role of actors in transitions: Insights from sociological theories
authors: Wittmayer J; Avelino F; van Steenbergen F; Loorbach D
abstract: We develop a framework for analyzing actor roles in transitions drawing on sociological role theory and transitions research.

title: Knowledge and Innovation Communities: The role of the EIT
abstract: This study examines how EIT Knowledge and Innovation Communities facilitate knowledge transfer and innovation across Europe.

title: Mapping innovation ecosystems: A network approach
authors: Basole R; Park H; Barnett B
abstract: We use network analysis and text mining to map the structure of innovation ecosystems from venture data.

title: Complex adaptive systems and sustainability transitions
journal: International Journal of Sustainability in Higher Education
abstract: We argue that sustainability transitions can be understood as processes in complex adaptive systems.

title: Visual social semiotics: A Hallidayan approach
abstract: We develop a grammar of visual design based on Halliday's systemic functional linguistics.

title: Power in discourse: The case of innovation policy
abstract: This paper examines how power relations are constructed through discourse in innovation policy contexts.

title: Connotation frames: A data-driven investigation
authors: Sap M; Prasettio M; Holber A; Rashkin H; Choi Y
abstract: We introduce connotation frames that capture subtle implications about power and agency in text.

title: RIVETER: Measuring power and agency in text
authors: Antoniak M; Mimno D; Levy K
abstract: We present RIVETER, a Python package for analyzing power and agency dimensions in text using verb connotations.

title: BERTopic: Neural topic modeling
abstract: BERTopic is a topic modeling technique that leverages BERT embeddings and class-based TF-IDF.
